title: Cognizant Agency: Definition for Nonprofits
seoTitle: Cognizant Agency Definition (Nonprofit Glossary)
metaDescription: A cognizant agency is the federal agency assigned to negotiate and approve a nonprofit's indirect cost rate on behalf of all federal awards.

title: Questioned Costs: Definition in Single Audits
seoTitle: Questioned Costs Definition (Single Audit Glossary)

title: Matching Funds: Definition for Grant Recipients
seoTitle: Matching Funds Definition (Grant Glossary)
metaDescription: Matching funds are non-federal resources — cash or in-kind — a grantee must contribute to a federally funded project, documented at the award rate.

title: Cost Share: Definition for Federal Grants
seoTitle: Cost Share Definition (Federal Grant Glossary)
metaDescription: Cost share is the portion of project costs not borne by the federal government — committed either as mandatory match or voluntary contribution.

title: Unallowable Costs: Definition Under 2 CFR 200
seoTitle: Unallowable Costs Definition (Federal Grant Glossary)
metaDescription: Unallowable costs are expenses 2 CFR 200 prohibits from federal award charges — including alcohol, bad debt, contributions, and lobbying.

title: Net Assets Without Donor Restrictions: Definition
